description:
20" Foldable Electric Bike – Power, Speed & Fat Tires for Ultimate Adventure
Tracer Coyote 20 Inch 500W Foldable Electric Bike for Adults, Shimano 7-Speed, Removable Battery, Disc Brake, 20x4.0 Fat Tire Electric Bike, 48V 12.5AH, Adult Electric Bicycles, Folding Ebikes for Adults

Removable Lithium Battery: Fully Charging Time: 4-6H, Weight: 7 LB, Working Time: 35-40 Miles. An extra battery available(sold separately).
Fit for People: from 5’ to 6‘2, below 300 LB. Seat and Handlebar are all height adjustable.
3 Working Modes: E-bike & Assisted bicycle & Normal bike. Perfect for whether you want to use it to work, casual, travel, park, beach, climb hills, neighborhood.
Premium Quality: Equipped with Aluminum Frame, Shimano 7-speed gearing system, disc brakes feature levers with motor inhibitors, LCD display, super bright front light.
Warranty Service: The Bicycle arrives 95% assembled. Easy to assemble and use.

This Lithium Battery 20 Inch Electric Folding Fat Bike is powered by 48V 12.5AH Li-ion battery which can be charged in 4-6 hours. It is constructed with aluminum alloy 6061. It can be folded for easy storage and transport. Equipped with 500W light weight high speed brushless rear wheel hub motor (EU), it can achieve a maximum speed of 20mile/h with a travel range of 20-25mile. It has an intelligent Pedals Assisted System which makes it like a normal bike and provides a natural riding experience.
